newsitem.title: USA: Sensormatic to sell division to Security Technologies.
newsitem.headline: Sensormatic to sell division to Security Technologies.

text.p: Security systems maker Sensormatic Electronics Corp. said Monday it signed a letter of intent to sell its U.S. Enterprise Accounts Division to Security Technologies Inc., a privately held security company based in Coral Gables, Florida.
Terms of the agreement were not disclosed.
Security Technologies' largest shareholder is Jules Kroll of Kroll Associates, with minority interests held by MCI Communications.
Following the news, the stock of Sensormatic Electronics rose 31 cents to $12.95 on the New York Stock Exchange.
